content.short: OXORIO is a blockchain security firm specializing in smart contracts, zk-SNARK solutions, and security consulting.
content.description: OXORIO is a blockchain security firm focused on smart contracts, zk-SNARK solutions, and security consulting. With a decade of blockchain development and five years in smart contract auditing, their team provides comprehensive security services for projects at any stage of maturity. Since 2021, OXORIO has performed security audits for notable DeFi projects including Lido, 1Inch, Rarible, and deBridge, emphasizing excellence and enduring client relationships.
